# Triple Moon Goddess

> Triple Moon Goddess is an integrative astrology web application built by Lisa Hagan. It maps your constitution from your birth data and returns health and growth profiles — free chart apps for individuals, a subscription platform for practitioners, and booking for 90-minute sessions with Lisa Hagan.

Triple Moon Goddess is the practice of Lisa Hagan, a psychological astrologer with 15 years of astrological practice. The methodology, Integrative Pattern Astrology, integrates training in psychological astrology, evolutionary herbalism, and traditional medical astrology. Consultations are 90 minutes.

## Sessions and readings

- [Schedule a Consultation](https://triplemoongoddess.com/schedule.html): Booking for 90-minute sessions with Lisa Hagan.
- [Relationship Reading](https://triplemoongoddess.com/readings.html): Relationship reading offering.
- [Birth Chart Video](https://triplemoongoddess.com/video.html): Birth chart video offering.
